$doc: n8n node operation -> connector tool (or an app REST request), read by scripts/convert.mjs. Keyed by n8n type -> typeVersion range -> resource -> operation ('_' when the node has no resource; triggers use operation 'poll'). Tool variants (gmailTool, ...) use the entry of the node they vary (nodes.json toolVariantOf).

Entry: connector, tool (the real tool name in references/connectors/<connector>.json), effect, args, result, fidelity, missingFields, caveats, understood, review. Or http (a request template for an app REST API without a tool) with credentialType and placement. Or blocked {kind, reason, alternative}.

args: tool input field -> spec. Specs are resolved at conversion time against the node's parameters; n8n expressions stay expressions and the runner evaluates them per item. Spec forms: "param.path" (a resource locator gives its value); {param, default}; {param, map: {n8nValue: toolValue}} (values not in the map are left out); {param, prefix}; {const}; {concat: [spec...], sep}; {if: {param, equals, default}, then, else}; {param, extract: "googleId"}; {param, extract: "spreadsheetId"} (n8n's getSpreadsheetId: a url-mode resource locator gives the id in it); {binary: param, default, field}; {param, json: true} (a JSON text parameter becomes an object); {param, default, when: param} (only when that parameter is set). http.site {path, id?} instead of http.url: the request goes to the person's site (the answer to the report's site question for the step's credential) plus path, then /<id parameter>. coerce "ifTruthy": the field is sent only when its value is truthy.

caveats: plain-words differences from n8n; an object {text, unless: {param, equals}} is left out when the parameter has that value. result: the declarative result adapter evaluated by the runtime (runtime/src/adapt.mjs), so downstream expressions see n8n's field names. fidelity: exact | adapted | partial | none | unverified. The tool schemas captured on 2026-11-14 carry input schemas only. Slack, Google Drive and Notion read outputs were captured from a real account on 2026-11-18 (evals/connectors/observed-2026-11-18.md): adapters checked against them read adapted or partial; the rest (writes, and every Gmail tool: that connector had no read scope) stay unverified. missingFields: n8n output fields (from n8n's own output schemas, n8n-nodes-base 2.47.5) that the adapter cannot supply.

understood: parameters this entry reads or accepts; any other parameter set on the node makes the step `review` (it has no counterpart in the tool). review: [{param, equals?, reason}] flags the step when a parameter has that value (any value when equals is absent).
The converter checks every args field against the tool's input JSON schema: required fields present, no unknown fields.
In a tool's args, the parameter "@typeVersion" is the node's version (for an if where versions take different parameters).

lookup: true (Google Sheets reads): the node's filtersUI rows become tool.lookup, applied by the runtime to the adapted rows as n8n's lookupValues does (cell text equals the value; OR or AND by combineFilters; first match per filter unless all matches are asked for).

Or rest (a REST program in runtime/src/rest.mjs, for an operation that takes several requests: a read decides the write) with credentialType and hosts [{method, host, pathPrefix}]; the n8n parameters stay in step.params. Keeping the same service over its REST API with the person's own credential is the default mapping, not a substitution (references/translation.md). site: true: the program's base is the person's site (the answer to the report's site question for the step's credential, convert.mjs siteBase(), kept as step.rest.base), and a host without a host name takes the site's host, with the site's path before pathPrefix. whenSiblingRest: true: the entry applies only to a step (not an agent tool) whose workflow has another step of the same node type on a REST entry under the same credential name, so the secret the person stores for those steps serves this one too; otherwise the next version range's entry applies (a Sheets read then goes through the Drive export).

recipients (a reply whose n8n node addresses it from the replied-to message's headers, as Gmail's reply): {tool, idArg, arg, from, replyTo, replyToFromVersion}. Before the call the runner reads the message (tool with idArg) and sets args[arg] to the addresses in its first present field of replyTo (only from replyToFromVersion on), else of from; a connector's own default recipients are never relied on.

detail (poll triggers whose n8n node reads each new item again, as Gmail's GET per message): {tool, args, idArg, idField, keep, result, resultWhen, missingFields}. After the cursor, the runner calls the tool once per new item with args plus idArg set to the list item's idField; the item becomes the adapted detail result (the resultWhen branch the node's parameters pick, which may carry its own missingFields); keep names list-item fields used when the detail result lacks them. The step's missingFields are the detail's.

credentialHosts.$doc: Hosts a credential type may be sent to, when the http steps that use it do not say (n8n credential base URLs). The entries after elevenLabsApi come from n8n-nodes-base and @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain 2.47.5 (n8n 2.47.7) credential definitions, only where the host is fixed or given by the credential's own field: the host of `test.request` baseURL or url when it is literal; else the base URL with each field at its default, plus hosts the expression writes literally (deepLApi, mailerLiteApi); microsoftOAuth2Api's graphApiBaseUrl default for the Microsoft types whose nodes use it; for OAuth2 types with no base URL in the definition, the node transport's fixed host (YouTube, Dropbox). Left out: hosts from a field without a default (NocoDB, Jira, S3's endpoint), AWS (region host and SigV4 signing), local defaults, placeholders, and nodes with no credential (Hacker News).
